comprehension.claim: For every admissible true trajectory, outer transition propagation followed by a measurement-compatible intersection and outward storage preserves true-state containment at every finite step.
comprehension.quantifiers: The initial condition and every transition, input, measurement and representation inclusion must hold along that trajectory. On one event E where all these premises hold simultaneously, containment holds simultaneously for all finite indices. Individual per-step probabilities do not establish that event.
comprehension.argument_checked: Inductively x_k in C_k and u_k in U_k place the true successor in the reach union, hence R_k; measurement validity places it in Y_(k+1), hence the decoded outer C_(k+1). No independence or deterministic dynamics is required.
comprehension.scope: A conditional set-containment lemma, not a coverage calibration, Bayesian posterior preservation, bounded-memory construction, useful-contraction result or deployment certificate.

remaining_application_obligations: Specify a complete state and transition relation containing actual physical evolution, aging and model discrepancy; establish initial support, including after lost history.

Provide input sets or a joint input/state relation containing the true possibilities, including missing current, temperature and unknown elapsed intervals. Unbounded sets remain mathematically admissible but may prevent useful estimates.
Qualify observation compatibility sets so they contain the true successor; use the entire state space when no valid observation constraint is available.

Prove reach and decoded-storage inclusions for actual numerical algorithms, rounding and compression. Coordinate boxes must bound projections of the relevant joint set; ordinary marginal credible intervals do not automatically suffice.

For probabilistic assurance construct and validate a single joint event covering initial support and all required time-indexed assumptions, with an explicit horizon or valid lifetime composition. The lemma supplies no such risk budget.
Prove any required useful contraction, query availability, resource bounds and implementation correspondence separately; containment alone permits arbitrarily loose sets.
Treat empty propagated/retained sets as an assumption or implementation inconsistency requiring handling; selecting an arbitrary point cannot restore the containment proof.

checks: separation of application obligations from theorem defects
